body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.88

Released on 2026-11-24.

A cloud render no longer stops a chunk as stalled while its video frames are still extracting. The 4K clip on screen plays its own file while its lighter preview copy is made, instead of showing a still.

## Fixes

- **Producer:** A cloud chunk is not stopped as stalled while its video frames are still extracting ([8cdf5b22dc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8cdf5b22dc2edf6766d2cd8c17e3b8d35883cdfa), [#8632](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8632)).
- **Player:** A film ready before load no longer times the frame's next own document from it ([779bed5c0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/779bed5c0a6da3c7364d441f8945c2d8a54a8cbe), [#8634](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8634))
- **Studio:** A media reader reads only the file it was opened on ([d04d8fe468](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d04d8fe4682b3672b13083da3c82e5f6966e9b78), [#8630](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8630)).
- **CLI:** Announce publish deprecation for new projects ([57ffe0b07d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/57ffe0b07d52a7d15da30107077b83786f8a19d5), [#8629](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8629)).
- **Core:** A held clip shows its own frame, not black, while its lighter copy is made ([66eeb13a92](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/66eeb13a92f225bcc4d706ef15233defc61c1c70), [#8618](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8618))
- **Core:** The 4K clip on screen plays its own file while its preview copy is made ([e2fe0e6f53](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e2fe0e6f53430f80efe50883e3d4dab86299689d), [#8602](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8602)).
- **CLI:** Layout check reads black covers as opaque and scores modern-colour gradients ([c9f9a52077](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9f9a5207778f9f3efe7db064f95ef4b9357269b), [#8628](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8628)).
- **Studio:** A failed preview's retry button takes a click again ([df57e691cb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/df57e691cbe95dc96f2c87fd868e04b5fdcd8085), [#8610](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8610)).

## Docs & Examples

- The quickstart's first door opens HyperFrames Studio in the browser, the download beside it ([34c7e64bb1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/34c7e64bb1997103474dbd0ab155767ff84f8543), [#8625](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8625)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.87

Released on 2026-11-23.

An edit's preview shows the change again within about a second, not after a five-second wait. Looped audio stays in sync in Safari, and a render's compile now stops at a deadline.

## Features

- **Studio:** Apps embedding Studio can style a sealed pick as Studio's panel does ([8376f32e0c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8376f32e0c8586c2055bc704724fa390beef54eb), [#8614](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8614)).

## Fixes

- **Player:** A slow load fails only past its system's limit, and a late timeline still fires ready ([dca98ed4c8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dca98ed4c84b3258cfee6d0feb80b37fbdd978d1), [#8594](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8594))
- **Studio:** A sealed scale resize the frame can't measure leaves no box size behind ([5336bddbf9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5336bddbf97618880fd5d64d4662977a2d8cdee1), [#8620](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8620))
- **Studio:** A preview frame served while its page loads keeps Studio's paused-frame decoder ([0a685496ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a685496add1da8027b10cf67dd698e799675c75), [#8613](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8613)).
- **Core:** Looped audio plays in sync with the picture in Safari ([32afb984bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32afb984bd1977ba5680f38d82657d44503a90fb), [#8612](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8612)).
- **Studio:** A second sealed resize of a scaled layer no longer jumps and saves the jump ([457cc56926](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/457cc5692685712c73c7358442b2484fbd1c321a), [#8565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8565)).
- **Core:** A film without a declared size reports its measured size to a sealed Studio ([19f98a3ed7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19f98a3ed77514641622af32706d6a33dbb1724e), [#8578](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8578)).
- **Studio:** A waiting press says whether it waits on the frame or a save ([d3c16bbe98](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d3c16bbe98365ee3050e33b267646b923848d6e3), [#8596](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8596)).
- **Producer:** A render's compile runs on its own thread and stops at a deadline ([590617475f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/590617475f6f2e4c592b1bc6783bb6dc49d5accf), [#8611](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8611)).
- **Studio:** An unsealed recording on an empty timeline records up to the composition's end ([4f863db6d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4f863db6d7995663d0f320cb433ab7a9f1d004fb), [#8606](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8606)).
- **CLI:** Read alpha from modern CSS colors ([bb87da4536](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb87da4536eef1058316eff0d5dfe0a05094f9ee), [#8624](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8624))
- **CLI:** Give --json the failure text as typed for cloud commands ([31be52d934](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/31be52d934344f05f763cc0115bb3d1f49c53b43), [#8607](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8607)).
- **CLI:** Show control characters as text in more lines that repeat a stored value ([8948e63cb7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8948e63cb7a27f2b74477cb4b2d5a7489b7ebc04), [#8603](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8603)).
- **CLI:** Mention hyperframes doctor after a browser download failure ([de4c73264e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/de4c73264e98f27f8f312fa55edc46f5446c48cf), [#7253](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7253)).
- **Media Use:** Dither stages its output in a fresh folder beside the output ([7717567650](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7717567650685ab2153b0ec8888e0f3af3229b1b), [#8599](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8599)).
- **Studio:** A ProRes clip's preview copy is no longer starved by thumbnail capture copies ([bebfdd13e9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bebfdd13e909b9aea05f3b7d1319f579cb28f2b2), [#8597](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8597)).
- **Core:** A sealed recording starts on a composition without GSAP ([bc33d032e5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bc33d032e55b387580fa7b383cf9cce139701e8b), [#8593](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8593)).

## Internal

- **Docs:** The banner and top button point to HyperFrames Studio in the browser ([80402d278a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80402d278a81b7788b9302825c3d896177e1c4b5), [#8619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8619))
- **CLI:** Count print calls whose value is not plainly the CLI's own ([c03897fc11](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c03897fc118f9d9f0a671ae4516180e7055b227c), [#8608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8608)).
- Run the studio tests in three shards so the job stops running out its time limit ([18bc914d24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/18bc914d249a38a1719dd5668af8de9ff388f5fd), [#8600](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8600)).

name: v0.9.86
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.86

Released on 2026-11-23.

A save during an import keeps its own undo step, and full-size stills count their real memory, so the cache frees them. Text on a sealed preview can now be edited in place, and sealed recordings move the layer live.

## Features

- **Studio:** Edit text in place on a sealed preview's canvas ([8d2783561](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8d2783561f4eb3038a2b6305cc9f160651834a12), [#8183](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8183)).

## Fixes

- **Studio:** A sealed gesture recording moves the layer live in the preview ([c0753d2ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c0753d2ad6beb46ab097b9a598d9408f8070c113), [#8592](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8592)).
- **Lint:** Read each linked file once and stop at one page's size limit ([70d547cac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70d547cace34c0107c4519f6e8d3df82cae828ac), [#8579](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8579)).
- **Studio:** A cancelled media read is not retried or logged as a failed fetch ([112e52c3c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/112e52c3c5bfd6e41f7616e7ddd0616684bcc146), [#8589](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8589)).
- **Studio Server:** A save asked to be recorded keeps its own undo step beside an import ([540938721](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5409387218cc0e695552f8a5dccac93484dc32c0), [#8585](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8585)).
- **Studio:** Keep a sealed drag's waiting outline until the frame draws its replay ([2cc423b3c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2cc423b3c63d682915ac7533da24afdd6af279d2), [#8588](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8588)).
- **Studio:** A sealed gesture recording keeps the layer's offset and the film's scale ([40ce145f2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/40ce145f27afc70f38e50199ba07cc298dfa4baa), [#8568](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8568)).
- **CLI:** A cloud upload leaves out a file it cannot read instead of failing ([76a6bacdf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/76a6bacdf748605bfe8cd36bf6eafaa3c09d92f8), [#8575](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8575)).
- **Studio:** Full-size composition stills count their real memory, so the cache lets them go ([e238ab7fa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e238ab7fa9bcf8f274027c209e06f0630bc112fd), [#8576](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8576)).
- **Core:** Count copied stylesheets and scene scripts toward a bundle's size limit ([96abfaf0d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/96abfaf0d01e67ed94f0149a99d8795b67fa79e0), [#8573](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8573)).
- **Studio:** A delete's toast names the undo key, as the ripple toast does ([871333e80](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/871333e80215dc460fe46d6f01083d85c2e0da3b), [#8571](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8571)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Describe the team descriptor in prose, not as a citation ([c451acae3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c451acae33789969c2f0e19774ea9df07a7100bc), [#8525](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8525)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Build the audio sidecar test's large video in well under a second ([646157c34](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/646157c34728327cd8640e659b60bc70d04abd55), [#8586](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8586)).
- **Studio:** Measure a sealed press by the element until the pointer moves ([2ce48f150](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ce48f150236ea635a510e6d783460122367c086), [#8582](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8582)).

## Other Changes

- Revert "test(studio): measure a sealed press by the element until the pointer moves (#8582)" ([ceaba3639](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ceaba36390d54e4459153b58f875bcb5a555955b), [#8591](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8591)).

name: v1.61.2
body:
### Patch Changes

- [#2561](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2561) [`7f51190`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/7f5119082a54ed199f987fac0d575cc48129557c) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - style(providers): show the colored Claude logo for the Anthropic provider and Claude models

- [#2562](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2562) [`b671615`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/b6716150ad51ab77ffe80aa4a1f8a664bce12a8c) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(context-menu): make the right-click actions on a selection work in the readfrog.app ebook reader

- [#2572](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2572) [`0fe2a30`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/0fe2a3080ddcae9d83dbacdd4f4c917fc4c0235e) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(providers): let guests pick the Built-in AI models signing in unlocks
  
  Logged-out users can now choose Built-in AI models in the provider menus, the popup and the options page instead of seeing them grayed out. Only models that need a plan the account would still lack after signing in, such as the Ultra models, stay locked, the same as for a free account. The menus' "LLM Models" group is now called "Third-party Models".

- [#2536](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2536) [`38ed1d0`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/38ed1d0498ab7e0159b6841df51dfe051aa73599) Thanks [@taiiiyang](https://github.com/taiiiyang)! - fix(subtitles): keep the subtitles a reader picks before an embedded video first plays. With subtitles set to start automatically, the first play of an X or embedded YouTube video replaced AI subtitles asked for beforehand with the video's own captions and turned back on subtitles the reader had switched off

- [#2565](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2565) [`8f83fb6`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/8f83fb6867ae844090b2efe83ab381d27444d8e4) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - feat(providers): add GPT-6.2, Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 models and drop retired ones
  
  Add GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon, Hydrogen and Neon, Nova 2 Lite and Fable 5.2 on Bedrock, GLM 5.3 on Mistral, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on OpenRouter, DeepInfra, Hugging Face, AtlasCloud and Alibaba, with thinking turned off like V4 Flash. Drop the models OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Moonshot, Groq, Cerebras and Mistral have shut down, and move providers that used them to the recommended replacement. Moonshot now defaults to Kimi K3, because Kimi K2.6 is closed to new Kimi accounts. DeepSeek now defaults to `deepseek-flash`, which serves V4.1 Flash, and providers on the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` move to it.

- [#2564](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2564) [`c8f922c`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/c8f922c5b26dc6c015f22c19cc7457109ffb1d15) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(selection): keep page content added after Read Frog's UI in Cmd/Ctrl+A on Chrome

- [#2573](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2573) [`b3f0ad0`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/b3f0ad0a0c64ba235b5dac0216ee500314a5864c) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - feat(subtitles): show translations right away at the start of a video and after a seek
  
  AI subtitles now send every line of the next 30 seconds at once, instead of one batch at a time. A line about to show before its AI translation arrives gets a Microsoft machine translation in the meantime. A line already on screen keeps that translation until it ends, and the transcript shows the AI translation at once. A batch that fails is now sent again 10 seconds later, or as soon as another batch comes back, instead of leaving its lines untranslated. While the line on screen has failed and no batch has come back since, the error shows in place of the subtitles, and it goes away by itself once a batch comes back. When the error is one every later batch would get too, such as a wrong key (401), an empty balance (402, or an OpenAI account with no balance), no permission (403), a wrong model (404), or Built-in AI refusing, translation stops at the first failure: the machine translations are removed, and the error stays on screen in place of the subtitles until you come back to the tab or change the subtitles provider. A subtitle error from a provider with your own key now starts with that provider's name, such as "OpenAI: You exceeded your current quota…", so it does not read as Read Frog's own. For a wrong key or no permission (401, 403), a rate limit (429) or a server error (500, 502, 503), the error now says so in Read Frog's words, as it was meant to; other errors, and an empty balance, keep the provider's own message. A long error is now cut short at the player's edge, with the whole text on hover. An OpenAI account with no balance is no longer retried as a rate limit for several minutes. Looking up a word in a subtitle now uses only the original line as context.

- [#2575](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2575) [`b5a29b9`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/b5a29b9de19f80904320c8a3d7fb411ff5bfb946) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(i18n): update outdated Built-in AI and provider copy across locales
  
  Updates Built-in AI standard and Ultra model descriptions, reserves "Built-in" wording for Read Frog's hosted models instead of preset third-party providers, unifies Built-in model labels across all 10 locales, and updates outdated OpenAI and API key warning copy.

- [#2559](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2559) [`2554145`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/2554145419941c7561f450bca3834818ba6113d2) Thanks [@taiiiyang](https://github.com/taiiiyang)! - feat(subtitles): request AI subtitles on X videos whose player shows no media id, such as uploads with a custom cover and live broadcast replays in a post. The server transcribes the post's only video. A replay's own captions arrive only a few seconds ahead of playback, so it now gets AI subtitles instead of a translation of its first seconds; GIFs and broadcasts still live get none

- [#2539](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2539) [`85008c1`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/85008c1b7e92834878fb963245cdbf61dc037993) Thanks [@taiiiyang](https://github.com/taiiiyang)! - feat(subtitles): request AI subtitles on X (Twitter) videos. A post with several videos transcribes the one being played, live broadcasts are turned away, a transcript of another video shows its own message instead of the wrong subtitles, and moving the pointer over another video while AI subtitles load no longer drops them

- [#2569](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2569) [`a5d61fb`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/a5d61fb69629fb981eba04df1bb6829e7b489ccd) Thanks [@taiiiyang](https://github.com/taiiiyang)! - fix(subtitles): show the Read Frog subtitles button on videos in X's media view, the full-screen viewer that opens over a post, so their captions can be translated and AI subtitles requested there too
